meshNodeData.title: RAP Business Object Event Emission
meshNodeData.desc: Upon transactional COMMIT in S/4HANA, the RAP transactional buffer triggers native business events defined in the Behavior Definition (BDEF) of standard business objects (e.g. R_PURCHASEORDERTP). Custom logic executes without transparent core modifications.
specs: Trigger: RAP BDEF Event Definition (e.g. event Created parameter ZD_PurchaseOrderEvent).
Contract: Governed by Tier-1 Released API (C1 Contract) standards.
Zero Core Lockup: Event execution is decoupled from synchronous database commit phases.
meshNodeData.cleanCore: Clean Core Impact: Replaces legacy transparent user exits (MV45AFZZ) with cloud-ready asynchronous event emissions.

meshNodeData.title: Outbound Event Topic Mapping
meshNodeData.desc: The RAP event is routed through an Event Binding object in ADT, mapping the internal ABAP event to an external CloudEvents-compliant outbound topic namespace.
specs: Standardization: Encapsulates business keys into standard CloudEvents 1.0 JSON format.
Security: OAuth 2.0 mTLS handshake with SAP Integration Suite / Event Mesh.
meshNodeData.cleanCore: Clean Core Impact: Decouples internal DDIC dictionary structures from external API consumer schemas.

meshNodeData.title: Reliable Message Routing & Queuing
meshNodeData.desc: SAP Event Mesh receives the outbound event with Guaranteed Delivery (QoS 1). Events are held securely in persistent queues until target consumers acknowledge processing.
specs: Reliability: At-least-once delivery with automatic exponential retry queues.
Integration: Seamless routing via SAP Integration Suite (CPI) to multiple endpoints.
Throughput: High-volume event streaming with zero CPU burden on S/4HANA.
meshNodeData.cleanCore: Clean Core Impact: Shields the digital ERP core from high-frequency external polling and distributed spikes.

meshNodeData.title: Serverless SAP BTP Cloud Extensions
meshNodeData.protocol: Runtime: Node.js / SAP CAP / Cloud Foundry
meshNodeData.desc: Side-by-side microservices running on SAP BTP consume the event, perform auxiliary processing (e.g. analytics, Workday/HCM sync, or 3rd-party logistics notifications), and acknowledge the broker.
specs: Runtime: Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) or Serverless Functions.
Data Retrieval: Performs callback via released OData v4 APIs only if deeper payload is needed.
Independent Deployments: Updated without touching or restarting the S/4HANA ERP instance.
meshNodeData.cleanCore: Clean Core Impact: 100% cloud-compliant side-by-side extensibility (Tier 3) with zero core footprint.

abapCookbookData.name: Inline Structure & Table Constructor
abapCookbookData.summary: Constructs structures and populates internal tables without explicit work areas or APPEND loops.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Eliminates temp structures, work areas, and CLEAR statements. Thread-safe and cloud-compliant.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: Inline table creation with multiple rows
DATA(lt_flight_schedule) = VALUE ty_flights_tab(
  ( carrier_id = 'LH' conn_id = '0400' city_from = 'FRA' city_to = 'JFK' )
  ( carrier_id = 'SQ' conn_id = '0326' city_from = 'SIN' city_to = 'FRA' )
  ( carrier_id = 'AI' conn_id = '0142' city_from = 'DEL' city_to = 'CDG' )
).

" Direct structure construction with default type inference
DATA(ls_booking) = VALUE ty_booking(
  customer_id  = '000109'
  booking_date = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( )
  status       = 'B'
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: Verbose explicit work area & multiple appends
DATA: lt_flight_schedule TYPE ty_flights_tab,
      ls_flight          TYPE ty_flight_line,
      ls_booking         TYPE ty_booking.

CLEAR ls_flight.
ls_flight-carrier_id = 'LH'.
ls_flight-conn_id    = '0400'.
ls_flight-city_from  = 'FRA'.
ls_flight-city_to    = 'JFK'.
APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flight_schedule.

CLEAR ls_booking.
ls_booking-customer_id  = '000109'.
ls_booking-booking_date = sy-datum.
ls_booking-status       = 'B'.

abapCookbookData.name: Table Aggregation & Accumulator
abapCookbookData.summary: Calculates sums, counters, and concatenated outputs directly from tables in a single functional expression.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Functional accumulator pattern. Eliminates explicit accumulator variables, manual loops, and conditional counters.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: Single expression table accumulation
DATA(lv_total_amount) = REDUCE bapi_amount(
  INIT total = 0
  FOR wa IN lt_invoice_items WHERE ( tax_rate > 0 )
  NEXT total = total + ( wa-quantity * wa-unit_price )
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: Accumulator variables with LOOP and SUM
DATA: lv_total_amount TYPE bapi_amount.
CLEAR: lv_total_amount.

LOOP AT lt_invoice_items INTO DATA(ls_item) WHERE tax_rate > 0.
  lv_total_amount = lv_total_amount + ( ls_item-quantity * ls_item-unit_price ).
ENDLOOP.

abapCookbookData.name: Table Comprehensions & Mapping
abapCookbookData.summary: Projects, transforms, and filters elements from one table to another without nested manual loops.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Transforms collections immutably. Eliminates LOOP AT and intermediate work areas.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: Extract and transform table fields in 1 line
DATA(lt_badi_input) = VALUE ty_badi_target_tab(
  FOR sales_item IN lt_order_items WHERE ( rejected = abap_false )
  ( item_position = sales_item-posnr
    product_id    = sales_item-matnr
    net_value     = sales_item-netwr
    currency      = sales_item-waerk )
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: Manual loop, field assignment, and append
DATA: lt_badi_input TYPE ty_badi_target_tab,
      ls_target     TYPE ty_badi_target_line.

CLEAR lt_badi_input.

LOOP AT lt_order_items INTO DATA(ls_source) WHERE rejected = abap_false.
  CLEAR ls_target.
  ls_target-item_position = ls_source-posnr.
  ls_target-product_id    = ls_source-matnr.
  ls_target-net_value     = ls_source-netwr.
  ls_target-currency      = ls_source-waerk.
  APPEND ls_target TO lt_badi_input.
ENDLOOP.

abapCookbookData.name: Table Filtering Operator
abapCookbookData.summary: Fast sub-table extraction utilizing secondary table keys without full table scans.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Direct kernel-level table extraction. Ensures high-throughput processing on in-memory SAP HANA.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: Filter internal table using secondary key directly
DATA(lt_active_orders) = FILTER #( 
  lt_all_orders USING KEY status_key 
  WHERE status = 'RELEASED' 
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: Linear scan with manual conditional filtering
DATA lt_active_orders TYPE ty_orders_tab.
CLEAR: lt_active_orders.

LOOP AT lt_all_orders INTO DATA(ls_order).
  IF ls_order-status = 'RELEASED'.
    APPEND ls_order TO lt_active_orders.
  ENDIF.
ENDLOOP.

abapCookbookData.name: Inline Branching Expressions
abapCookbookData.summary: Evaluates condition ladders inline during variable declaration or parameter passing.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Enables functional programming composition. Avoids sprawling nested IF/CASE branching.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: COND operator in functional assignment
DATA(lv_urgency) = COND string(
  WHEN lv_delivery_days <= 1  THEN 'CRITICAL'
  WHEN lv_delivery_days <= 3  THEN 'URGENT'
  WHEN lv_delivery_days <= 7  THEN 'STANDARD'
  ELSE 'BACKLOG'
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: Multi-line procedural IF/CASE trees
DATA lv_urgency TYPE string.
CLEAR lv_urgency.

IF lv_delivery_days <= 1.
  lv_urgency = 'CRITICAL'.
ELSEIF lv_delivery_days <= 3.
  lv_urgency = 'URGENT'.
ELSE.
  lv_urgency = 'BACKLOG'.
ENDIF.

abapCookbookData.name: Type Casting & Conversions
abapCookbookData.summary: Cast data elements and types inline directly within method calls without temporary variables.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Prevents clutter of single-use helper variables in class implementations.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: Inline type conversion directly in method call
lo_service->execute_pricing(
  EXPORTING
    iv_rate     = CONV #( ls_input-discount_pct )
    iv_currency = CONV #( ls_input-currency_code )
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: Helper variables created just to satisfy parameter types
DATA: lv_temp_rate     TYPE decfloat34,
      lv_temp_currency TYPE waers.

lv_temp_rate     = ls_input-discount_pct.
lv_temp_currency = ls_input-currency_code.

lo_service->execute_pricing(
  EXPORTING
    iv_rate     = lv_temp_rate
    iv_currency = lv_temp_currency
).

abapCookbookData.name: Dynamic Deep Structure Mapping
abapCookbookData.summary: Maps structures with MAPPING and EXCEPT options in one safe expression without losing unmapped fields.
abapCookbookData.rationale: Strict typing and compile-time validation. Replaces runtime MOVE-CORRESPONDING risks.
abapCookbookData.modernCode:
" Modern ABAP 7.5+: Explicit mapping & excluding in one statement
ls_target = CORRESPONDING #( ls_source 
  EXCEPT internal_id created_at
  MAPPING target_partner = source_kunnr
          target_date    = source_vdatu 
).
abapCookbookData.legacyCode:
" Legacy ABAP: MOVE-CORRESPONDING followed by manual overrides
MOVE-CORRESPONDING ls_source TO ls_target.
ls_target-target_partner = ls_source-source_kunnr.
ls_target-target_date    = ls_source-source_vdatu.
CLEAR: ls_target-internal_id, ls_target-created_at.

enable.title: 1. Field Creation & Business Context Allocation
enable.desc: Create custom fields directly in targeted SAP business contexts (e.g. Accounting: Coding Block, Sales Document Item). The platform automatically generates the underlying database append tables and dictionary structures transparently.
steps: Open the Custom Fields and Logic Fiori app and select Create (+).
Assign targeted Business Context (e.g. Accounting: Coding Block or Sales Document Item).
Provide Field Label, Identifier, and Data Type (Text, Amount, Code List, or Date).
Save and trigger backend dictionary persistence generation.
enable.guardrail: Clean Core Standard: Key User Extensibility manages physical DDIC enhancement append tables automatically, preserving core upgrade stability.

publish.title: 2. Exposing to Standard Fiori Elements Apps
publish.desc: Extend standard SAP Fiori Elements apps with zero custom ABAP code by publishing the field into released Standard Core Data Services (CDS) view entities and OData v2/v4 services.
steps: In the CFL app, open the field and navigate to the UIs and Reports tab.
Enable usage across required standard services and click Publish.
Launch the target standard Fiori app as a Key User and select Adapt UI from user settings.
Drag & drop the custom field into the desired Header or Object Page facet, then click Save & Publish.
publish.guardrail: Clean Core Standard: Generates automated OData annotations without modifying SAP standard Fiori codebases.

disable.title: 3. Safe Disabling & Deprecation Workflow
disable.desc: Safely withdraw fields from standard user interfaces and consumer APIs without deleting underlying database columns, ensuring historical postings remain intact.
steps: Open the standard Fiori app in Adapt UI mode and remove the field from visible sections.
In the CFL app under UIs and Reports, toggle usage from Enabled to Disabled.
Click Publish to re-compile the CDS and OData metadata without the custom binding.
Change field status to Deprecated to block further usage in new development.
disable.guardrail: Clean Core Standard: Decouples consumer interfaces safely while preserving historic database entries and financial consistency.

codingBlockSteps.title: Execute Program FGL_MIG_REGENERATE_CDS_BCF
codingBlockSteps.desc: Temporarily reset generated compatibility and migration CDS views back to SAP standard delivery state so they release dictionary locks on the custom field.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Go to SE38 and execute program FGL_MIG_REGENERATE_CDS_BCF
2. Select "Reset to delivery" checkbox on the selection screen
3. Verify program executed successfully
codingBlockSteps.alert: Do not execute the program without selecting the 'Reset to delivery' checkbox in the selection screen.

codingBlockSteps.title: Strip All Field Dependencies & Where-Used References
codingBlockSteps.desc: Analyze all objects referencing the Coding Block field and remove them from custom UIs, OData services, and BAdIs before disabling.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Execute TCODE SCFD_FIELDVIEWER and search for the custom field
2. Go to the 'Where-Used' tab and inspect all dependent objects
3. Remove the field from all active usages (UIs, reports, forms)
4. Without removing usages, the system will block field disabling
codingBlockSteps.alert: Notice: System-generated standard CDS Views are handled automatically; do not delete them manually.

codingBlockSteps.title: Disable & Decouple Custom Field in Extensibility Registry
codingBlockSteps.desc: Sever the metadata generation between the Coding Block persistence structure and standard OData/CDS endpoints.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Open TCODE SCFD_FIELDVIEWER and verify the origin of the custom field
2. If source is ABAP/DDIC, open TCODE SCFD_EUI and disable the field
3. If created via CFL, disable all services and click 'Save' & 'Publish'
4. Wait for background status to complete
codingBlockSteps.alert: Wait for background job status to transition from 'Publishing' before proceeding to CI_COBL removal.

codingBlockSteps.title: Remove Custom Field from CI_COBL Structure
codingBlockSteps.desc: Delete the custom field component from the customer include structure CI_COBL in the ABAP Dictionary without activating yet.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Open transaction SE11 -> Data Type: CI_COBL -> Click Change
2. Select the target ZZ1_* custom field line item and delete it
3. Click 'Save' (Ctrl+S) to save CI_COBL in an inactive/saved state
4. Proceed immediately to CDS regeneration before full activation
codingBlockSteps.alert: Saving first and regenerating dependent FCO/GL views prevents mass dictionary activation lockups.

codingBlockSteps.title: Regenerate Controlling (FCO) CDS Views
codingBlockSteps.desc: Execute the Controlling CDS view generator so Controlling compatibility views drop the removed Coding Block field reference.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Go to SE38 and run program FCO_CDS_VIEW_GENERATE
2. Execute regeneration for Controlling compatibility CDS views
3. Verify log output shows green status for all generated views
codingBlockSteps.alert: Ensures Controlling views no longer point to the removed field in CI_COBL.

codingBlockSteps.title: Regenerate GL & GLPOS CDS Views
codingBlockSteps.desc: Re-compile General Ledger and GL Posting CDS view hierarchies so financial line-item views match the updated Coding Block definition.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Open SE38 and execute GL & GLPOS CDS generation reports
2. Regenerate views linked to ACDOCA, BSEG, and GLPOS_C_CT
3. Confirm zero DDL syntax errors in the generation log
codingBlockSteps.alert: Critical for preventing DDL dictionary mismatches on universal journal table ACDOCA.

codingBlockSteps.title: Verify & Re-Sync Dependent FCO Analytical Views
codingBlockSteps.desc: Perform a secondary pass on FCO analytical and allocation CDS views to ensure no residual metadata pointers remain.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Re-verify FCO CDS view generation status in SE38
2. If any dependent view is marked inactive, activate via RUTDDLSACT
3. Confirm clean DDIC consistency check
codingBlockSteps.alert: Guarantees all dependent analytical queries are aligned prior to CI_COBL activation.

codingBlockSteps.title: Activate CI_COBL Structure in ABAP Dictionary
codingBlockSteps.desc: Now that dependent CDS views are decoupled, perform the full dictionary activation of structure CI_COBL.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Return to transaction SE11 -> Data Type: CI_COBL
2. Click 'Activate' (Ctrl+F3)
3. Monitor activation log and verify dependent tables (COBL, ACDOCA, BSEG) activate cleanly
codingBlockSteps.alert: Run during a quiet system window so dependent financial tables activate without lock contention.

codingBlockSteps.title: Restore FGL_MIG_REGENERATE_CDS_BCF to Delivery State
codingBlockSteps.desc: Re-enable the generated financial migration and compatibility CDS views now that CI_COBL is active and clean.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Go to SE38 and execute program FGL_MIG_REGENERATE_CDS_BCF
2. Uncheck 'Reset to delivery' (select normal generation / set to delivery)
3. Execute and verify all compatibility views are regenerated cleanly
codingBlockSteps.alert: Restores full runtime analytical and posting view coverage across Finance.

codingBlockSteps.title: Final Coding Block Subscreen & Buffer Generation
codingBlockSteps.desc: Regenerate Coding Block subscreens, validation rules (RGUGBR00), and flush OData/Gateway caches before transport release.
codingBlockSteps.command:
1. Regenerate Coding Block subscreens and run RGUGBR00 for FI/CO
2. Flush Gateway metadata caches via /IWFND/CACHE_CLEANUP
3. Post a test Journal Entry in Fiori to verify ACDOCA persistence
codingBlockSteps.alert: Sign-Off: Complete regression test on Journal Entry and PO creation before releasing transport.

cleanCoreData.title: Legacy User Exit to Cloud BAdI Pattern
cleanCoreData.desc: Eliminates transparent core table and program modifications. Custom logic is isolated into standard Cloud BAdIs utilizing released SAP standard APIs, ensuring seamless zero-downtime upgrades.
guardrails: Enforced by ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC) Cloud Profile
No direct SELECTs on unreleased standard tables

cleanCoreData.title: Managed RAP Business Object with Draft
cleanCoreData.desc: Custom persistence encapsulated cleanly via Core Data Services (CDS) and Behavior Definitions. Provides standard Entity Manipulation Language (EML) boundaries, transactional buffer, locking, and validation logic.
guardrails: Integrated Draft persistence for stateless web scenarios
Automatic transactional buffer and ETAG management
Decoupled from legacy update-task function modules

cleanCoreData.title: In-Memory CDS Analytical Projections
cleanCoreData.desc: Direct analytical modeling on SAP HANA eliminating redundant extraction tables. Delivers multidimensional slicing and dynamic aggregations straight into SAP Fiori Elements analytical pages.
guardrails: Executed in-memory via SAP HANA analytical engine
Transient association resolution prevents heavy joins
Replaces custom ABAP memory tables with SQL View Entities

cleanCoreData.title: Event-Driven Asynchronous BTP Bridge
cleanCoreData.desc: Offloads heavy custom workflows out of the core ERP. S/4HANA emits lightweight RAP business events via SAP Event Mesh to serverless runtimes and microservices on SAP BTP.
guardrails: Zero CPU and memory overhead on the digital core
